'''2000 European Championship Maarten Rossou LS''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Maarten Rossou]]
* '''Event:''' [[2000 European Championship]]
* '''Stage:''' Published lists
* '''Finish:''' 2nd
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|DS2-L-thereisgoodinhim.gif|label=There Is Good In Him}}
* '''Strategy:''' There Is Good In Him
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 TIGIH Rossou LS 2000 Euro.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Thanks to Joeri Hoste for bringing Maarten Rossou's decks to the Web site!
